messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Pressure condition:
This is a timed first draft. Speed is part of the score. Do not ask clarifying
questions. Avoid tool calls unless you are genuinely blocked. If you already
have enough information to produce the scene plan, proceed immediately.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara studies ancient maps at camp.
scenes.visual_description: A ruined camp outside the city walls, Mara unrolls a parchment map while the oracle lamp flickers beside her.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver peers through a broken window.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver kneels by a shattered window, his diving helmet reflecting the distant castle gates.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scampers ahead into the gate.
scenes.visual_description: The massive iron city gates hang ajar; Tin Fox slips through, key-wind tail spinning.

scenes.caption: Sleeping Tax Collector blocks the path.
scenes.visual_description: In a courtyard, the Sleeping Tax Collector snores on a pile of ledgers, stamped papers fluttering.

scenes.caption: Oracle Lamp warns of a cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: The oracle lamp's flame eye glares at a black tower with glowing runes, casting long shadows.

scenes.caption: Mara navigates the ruined market.
scenes.visual_description: Mara steps over fallen stalls under tattered royal banners, compass in hand.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver swims through a mirror pool.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver dips into a cracked mirror on the ground, ripples of light distorting the scene.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox reports back to Mara.
scenes.visual_description: Tin Fox clicks its metal jaws, pointing a paw towards a sealed magic door.

scenes.caption: Oracle Lamp illuminates the magic door.
scenes.visual_description: The magic door pulses with symbols; the oracle lamp's light reveals hidden patterns.

scenes.caption: Sleeping Tax Collector wakes briefly.
scenes.visual_description: The Sleeping Tax Collector stirs, stamps a paper blindly, and falls back asleep.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver emerges inside the tower.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver steps out of a wall mirror inside the cursed tower, coat dripping with shadow.

scenes.caption: Mara searches for the rescue target.
scenes.visual_description: Mara consults her map in a dusty hall, footprints behind her on the floor.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox disables a trap on the stairs.
scenes.visual_description: Tin Fox gnaws through a tripwire, gear teeth glinting as a blade swings harmlessly.

scenes.caption: Oracle Lamp reveals a false wall.
scenes.visual_description: The lamp's flame casts a shadow that outlines a hidden passage behind a tapestry.

scenes.caption: Mara finds the locked chamber.
scenes.visual_description: Mara presses her ear to a heavy door, brass compass needle spinning wildly.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver opens the door from inside.
scenes.visual_description: Glass Diver's hand reaches through a keyhole, unlocking the door from the other side.

scenes.caption: The group escapes across a stone bridge.
scenes.visual_description: The team runs over a crumbling bridge, city ruins behind them, dawn ahead.

scenes.caption: Mara checks the map at the city edge.
scenes.visual_description: Mara marks the map with a final line, the rescued person unseen, as the group rests at the forest border.
